# Cost Governance Review

Use this skill when architecture affects cloud cost, licensing, enterprise approvals, quotas, capacity, data transfer, storage growth, or governance.

## Procedure

1. Assign `COST-###` and `GOV-###`.
2. Identify cost drivers, licensing assumptions, capacity assumptions, quotas, tagging, budget controls, approval gates, and ownership.
3. Flag unconfirmed enterprise editions, license entitlements, budget limits, and capacity commitments.
4. Link cost/governance findings to ADRs and risks.

**Why?** Cost and governance risks often block architecture approval late.
